performance-minimal.label: Performance Minimal
performance-minimal.design_rule: Low-friction, fast-scanning, one dominant CTA, minimal decorative weight.

premium-editorial.label: Premium Editorial
premium-editorial.design_rule: Editorial pacing, premium whitespace, strong typography, restrained decoration.

commerce-product.label: Commerce Product
commerce-product.design_rule: Product evidence high in the hierarchy, compact benefit copy, strong return-to-shop CTA.

proof-first.label: Proof First
proof-first.design_rule: Lead with credible evidence, mechanism and risk reduction before the CTA.

founder-human.label: Founder Human
founder-human.design_rule: Human voice, visually light presentation, natural reply behaviour, minimal sales-page feel.
